reason: Honestly the free tricks would be enough for me. I'd show the calculator one at Friday dinner, everyone laughs, and by next week it's sitting on my phone forgotten. Paying 99 for something I'll use twice is not me.
objection: I'll use it twice and get bored, and 99 shekels for a toy that the family figures out after two dinners feels like a lot. Also installing from the browser and putting my card on some website, not the App Store, makes me a bit nervous.
would_change_my_mind: If the free tricks really blew everyone away at dinner and the full version were around 30-40 shekels, I'd probably buy it on the spot.
